name: Check Dam UoH
description: Scenic stone check dam in the south-western campus basin channeling seasonal rainwater into lush natural aquifers.
trivia: A tranquil sanctuary frequented by migrating herons and kingfishers after monsoon showers.

name: ASPIRE BioNEST
description: Premier biotechnology incubator and life science enterprise accelerator supporting cutting-edge bio-ventures.
trivia: Houses high-end biosafety incubators, fermentation suites, and genomics startups founded by UoH alumni.

name: Prof. Manjula Sridharan Lab / School of Life Sciences
description: Iconic concentric multi-wing complex housing Biochemistry, Plant Sciences, Animal Biology, and Biotechnology departments.
trivia: Renowned for pioneering research in molecular biology, plant genetics, and neurobiology.

name: Greenhouse & Botanical Research Nursery
description: Lush botanical greenhouse and nursery cultivating medicinal flora, rare orchids, and research seedlings.
trivia: Maintained by the School of Life Sciences for botanical genetics and biodiversity propagation.

name: Centre for Integrated Studies
description: Flagship academic building for integrated 5-year Master's programs across Sciences, Humanities, and Social Sciences.
trivia: The vibrant home of UoH's energetic integrated batch students with buzzing common corridors.

name: South Campus Student Study Lounge
description: Quiet air-conditioned study hall with high-speed Wi-Fi, individual cubicles, and academic reference materials.
trivia: A favorite haven for late-evening exam preparation and thesis writing.

name: Centre for Nanotechnology
description: Advanced research facility with clean rooms, electron beam lithography, and nanomaterial synthesis laboratories.
trivia: Pioneering novel nanomaterials for clean energy storage, biosensors, and quantum devices.

name: International Students Hostel Central
description: Modern residential complex hosting international research scholars, exchange students, and visiting fellows.
trivia: Celebrates global international food nights and cultural celebrations representing dozens of countries.

name: South Shopping Complex
description: Lively commercial and culinary hub on South Campus with grocery stores, bakeries, juice stalls, and late-night food joints.
trivia: Famous for late-night chai debates and post-dinner egg rolls amongst hostelers.

name: Tagore International House
description: Historic residential building named after Nobel Laureate Rabindranath Tagore, fostering cross-cultural residential community.
trivia: Features peaceful courtyards surrounded by neem trees and garden pathways.

name: Men's Hostel J, University of Hyderabad
description: Multi-floor residential hostel housing post-graduate and research scholars on South Campus.
trivia: Known for spirited inter-hostel cricket match watch parties in the common hall.

name: Men's Hostel I
description: Spacious hostel quadrangle located adjacent to the southern residential greenery.
trivia: Enjoys panoramic views of the Deccan rocky ridges at sunset.

name: MHK Hostel
description: Maulana Hasrat Mohani Hostel (MHK), one of the most prominent residential dormitories on South Campus.
trivia: Features an active recreation room with table tennis, study cubicles, and a cozy dining mess.

name: Ladies Hostel 8
description: Secure residential complex for women postgraduate scholars and researchers.
trivia: Surrounded by lush bougainvillea hedges and peaceful outdoor seating benches.

name: Ladies Hostel 10
description: Modern multi-storey women's residential hostel with study halls and solar-heated water facilities.
trivia: Surrounded by neat brick-paved walking paths and quiet outdoor study gazebos.

name: Volleyball Court
description: Floodlit clay/sand volleyball court bustling with energetic matches every evening.
trivia: Host to high-voltage inter-hostel championship tournaments under stadium floodlights.

name: Globbo Rock
description: A magnificent 2.5-billion-year-old spherical granite boulder perched naturally on the central granite plateau.
trivia: One of Hyderabad's finest natural geological marvels, protected under campus heritage heritage.

name: Chinna Gudi Heritage Temple
description: Historic hillock temple (Chinna Gudi) tucked into the rocky woods, offering peace and panoramic sunrise views.
trivia: Students often visit before crucial examinations to ring the brass bell for good luck.

name: Tamarind Tree
description: Century-old majestic tamarind tree marking the historic crossroad between central campus and the Amphitheatre trail.
trivia: A beloved natural canopy providing cool shade for reading and birdwatching.

name: Amphi Lake
description: Serene natural water body cradled alongside the open-air Amphitheatre.
trivia: Home to resident freshwater turtles, white egrets, and blooming water lilies.

name: Amphitheatre UoH
description: Magnificent stepped open-air stone amphitheater hosting university drama plays, music fests, and cultural gatherings.
trivia: Under moonlit skies, students gather here for acoustic guitar jam sessions and poetry recitals.

name: Secret Lake
description: Secluded ecological gem surrounded by dense wild shrubbery and rocky hillocks.
trivia: A treasured quiet hideaway for nature photographers and wildlife enthusiasts.

name: Horticulture Department Nursery
description: Extensive university botanical nursery propagating native flowering plants, medicinal herbs, and avenue trees.
trivia: Supplies beautiful saplings and blooming flora for all campus afforestation and landscaping drives.

name: Cherry Rock
description: Distinctive pinkish-granite natural rock formation standing sentinel along the eastern nature trail.
trivia: Glows with a warm cherry-amber hue when illuminated by the setting Hyderabad sun.

name: Aquarium Rock
description: Fascinating natural cavernous monolith formation with natural hollow rock basins that hold rainwater.
trivia: Ancient weathering carved natural glass-clear pools into the stone where tiny freshwater biomes thrive.

name: Buffalo Lake
description: Placid campus lake where gentle herds of spotted deer and indigenous buffalo drink during twilight.
trivia: A premier birdwatching haven where migratory pintails and teals visit during winter.

name: The Masoom's Rock
description: Breathtaking natural balancing monolith rock, affectionately celebrated in campus folklore as Masoom's Rock.
trivia: Perched precariously for millions of years defying gravity, it is one of UoH's most iconic natural landmarks.

name: Peacock Lake
description: Expansive shimmering lake nestled in the protected southern wildlife sanctuary.
trivia: Indian peafowl roam freely along its banks at dawn, displaying vibrant iridescent feathers.

name: Auroya Dam
description: Engineered stone weir and reservoir dam regulating watershed flow between the lakes.
trivia: Provides a magnificent vantage point across the dense southern forest canopy.

name: Indoor Stadium and Gym
description: Comprehensive indoor sports complex featuring badminton courts, table tennis arenas, and modern gymnasium.
trivia: Produced multiple national-level university athletes and inter-university championship teams.

name: State Bank of India (SBI) Campus Branch & ATM
description: Full-service on-campus State Bank of India branch, ATM kiosk, and scholarship stipend center.
trivia: A busy hub during the first week of every month when student fellowship stipends are processed.

name: Hostel C
description: North campus men's postgraduate hostel quadrangle situated close to the library and sciences.
trivia: Boasts a breezy open-air terrace with sweeping views of the northern hillocks.

name: North Shopping Complex
description: Central North commercial arcade housing photocopy centers, bookbinders, general stores, and tea shops.
trivia: Lifesaver for emergency assignment prints and midnight stationery supplies.

name: Men's Hostel H
description: Spacious north campus men's dormitory with comfortable residential wings and tree-lined walkways.
trivia: Known for vibrant hostel day cultural feasts and festive decorations.

name: Men's Hostel D (MH-D)
description: Adjacent twin hostel quadrangle serving senior research scholars and master's students.
trivia: Surrounded by shaded banyan trees where scholars gather for evening discussions.

name: Administration Building
description: The administrative heart of the university housing the Vice Chancellor's Secretariat, Registrar, and Finance Office.
trivia: The grand white portico is the official welcoming landmark for dignitaries and new university scholars.

name: Admission Office
description: Central admissions counter handling national entrance verification, certificates, and scholar enrollment.
trivia: The very first official stepping stone where students collect their university registration badges.

name: Health Center
description: 24x7 primary medical clinic, pharmacy dispensary, and emergency care unit serving the entire campus community.
trivia: Equipped with round-the-clock ambulance emergency response and free doctor consultations.

name: Tea and Snack Shop
description: Cozy roadside kiosk serving hot filter coffee, Osmania biscuits, and freshly fried samosas.
trivia: A favorite quick pit-stop for researchers walking between the East Gate and main academic complex.

name: Centre for Advancement of Bovine Breeding
description: Specialized animal biotechnology and genetics research institute focusing on indigenous livestock breeding.
trivia: Maintains dedicated research facilities for embryo transfer, cryopreservation, and livestock genetics.

name: HCU Small Gate / Security Office
description: Eastern pedestrian and two-wheeler access gate connecting to the vibrant Gachibowli-Lingampally road.
trivia: Manned 24/7 by friendly campus security checking student ID smart cards.

name: Karthik Sim Cards and Xerox
description: Popular student service shop offering mobile recharge, SIM activations, book spiral binding, and thesis printing.
trivia: The go-to shop for scholars submitting hardbound PhD and MTech final theses.

name: Department of Music
description: Acoustically treated department nurturing Carnatic and Hindustani classical vocal and instrumental music.
trivia: Melodious veena, sitar, and mridangam practice notes drift across the surrounding grove in the evenings.

name: CV Raman Auditorium
description: Prominent auditorium named in honor of Nobel Laureate Sir C. V. Raman, hosting international science conferences.
trivia: Regularly hosts Nobel laureate public lectures and prestigious national science conclaves.

name: School of Computer and Information Sciences
description: Premier department for AI, machine learning, systems, cyber security, and high-performance computing.
trivia: Features high-end GPU computing clusters and 24/7 labs where legendary hackathons take place.

name: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Lecture Hall Complex (SRK LHC)
description: Major interdisciplinary lecture theater complex with smart audiovisual tiered halls.
trivia: Named to commemorate both UoH's 25th Silver Jubilee and philosopher-statesman Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.

name: Savitribai Phule DST Auditorium
description: Modern auditorium dedicated to pioneer social reformer and educator Savitribai Phule.
trivia: Acoustically tuned for university symposiums, theatre festivals, and academic convocations.

name: Social Science Complex
description: Home to the School of Social Sciences spanning History, Political Science, Sociology, Economics, and Anthropology.
trivia: Famous for intellectually stimulating debates on policy, development, and social justice.

name: Central Instruments Laboratory / Electronics Block
description: Central analytical instrumentation facility with advanced NMR, XRD, Mass Spectrometry, and electron microscopes.
trivia: Serves researchers and doctoral scientists across India with precision nanoscale materials characterization.

name: Centre for Neural & Cognitive Sciences (CNCS)
description: Specialized interdisciplinary laboratory for cognitive science, computational neuroscience, and neural theory research.
trivia: Pioneering brain-computer interaction and cognitive linguistics in India.

name: IGM Library, UoH
description: Indira Gandhi Memorial Library, one of India's largest university repositories with over 400,000 volumes.
trivia: Features 24/7 air-conditioned reading halls, rare manuscript archives, and quiet study carrels.

name: School of Humanities
description: Prestigious academic school housing English, Hindi, Telugu, Urdu, Philosophy, and Comparative Literature.
trivia: Regularly hosts international literary symposiums, poetry translations, and philosophical dialogues.

name: Department of Sanskrit Studies
description: Department dedicated to computational linguistics, Sanskrit literature, and ancient Indian scientific treatises.
trivia: Pioneered worldwide NLP algorithms using Paninian Sanskrit grammar for computational parsing.

name: SN School Theatre & Performing Arts Wing
description: Dedicated performing arts studio for theatrical rehearsals, dramatics, stagecraft, and visual arts exhibitions.
trivia: Features expansive wooden stage floors where legendary student productions are staged.

name: SN School Media & Broadcast Studio
description: State-of-the-art journalism, television broadcasting, sound mixing, and Bol Hyderabad radio recording studio.
trivia: Equipped with professional TV broadcast cameras and acoustic audio mixing suites.

name: Sarojini Naidu School Main Building
description: Flagship academic headquarters of the Sarojini Naidu School of Arts & Communication.
trivia: Known for classical dance recitals and vibrant student cultural festivals.

name: VC Camp Office
description: Executive annex office assisting the Vice Chancellor in campus governance and emergency administrative tasks.
trivia: Surrounded by landscaped heritage gardens and historic stone pillars.

name: Vice Chancellor's Residence
description: The official colonial-style heritage residence of the Vice Chancellor of the University of Hyderabad.
trivia: Surrounded by ancient banyan groves where peacocks and deer wander peacefully.

name: Sukoon Canteen
description: Beloved campus open-air cafe nestled under large shady trees, serving steaming chai, parathas, and samosas.
trivia: The epicentre of intellectual debates, musical jamming, and friendships across departments.

name: UGC-NRC Canteen
description: Convenient dining cafe serving scientific researchers, mathematics scholars, and chemistry students.
trivia: Renowned for its freshly brewed South Indian filter coffee and evening dosa snacks.

name: School of Chemistry Annex Building
description: Modern synthetic and materials chemistry research laboratories equipped with advanced fume hoods and laser spectroscopy.
trivia: Ranked consistently among India's top chemical science research facilities.

name: CR Rao Advanced Institute of Mathematics
description: C.R. Rao Advanced Institute of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science, dedicated to foundational mathematical sciences.
trivia: Named after legendary statistician Prof. C.R. Rao, pioneer of the Cramér-Rao bound.

name: Tennis Court - UoH
description: Championship standard synthetic hard-surface tennis courts with floodlighting for evening matches.
trivia: Venue for inter-collegiate tennis tournaments and student training camps.

name: Ladies Hostel 1
description: Historic residential hostel for women scholars on the scenic eastern side of campus.
trivia: Surrounded by flowering frangipani trees and lush green lawn courtyards.

name: Ladies Hostel 2
description: Comfortable multi-storey residential complex overlooking the eastern nature forest.
trivia: Students often spot peacocks strolling right outside their hostel balcony gardens.

name: Ladies Hostel 3 and Mess
description: Hostel complex with an expansive central dining hall serving wholesome student meals.
trivia: Known for delicious special feast days and festival celebrations.

name: Ladies Hostel 4
description: Modern residential dormitory situated near the southern peacock nature sanctuary.
trivia: Enjoys soothing fresh breezes coming off Peacock Lake during summer evenings.

name: Men's Hostel M (MH-M)
description: Prominent men's hostel accommodating postgraduate scholars from arts, communications, and sciences.
trivia: Famous for its energetic common room table-tennis and chess battles.

name: Campus Dhobi & Laundry Center
description: Central campus facility providing professional laundry washing, dry cleaning, and ironed clothing services.
trivia: A time-honoured student essential for weekly hostel laundry.

name: East Campus Faculty Residences
description: Peaceful leafy residential enclave housing distinguished professors, faculty, and their families.
trivia: Nestled amongst tall mahogany trees with quiet walking paths and children's play parks.

name: East Boundary Security Gate
description: Manned security barrier and boom barrier controlling entry into the eastern residential sectors.
trivia: Safeguards the quiet residential neighborhoods along the forest fringe.

name: Silver Jubilee Guest House
description: University guest house offering hospitality, suites, and dining for visiting professors, examiners, and delegates.
trivia: Overlooks a peaceful landscaped rock garden with fountains and palm trees.

name: Central Workshop
description: Precision mechanical, electrical, and carpentry engineering workshop supporting experimental scientific apparatus.
trivia: Fabricates custom research components, metal chambers, and precision scientific instruments.

name: India Post
description: University campus post office (PIN: 500046) handling letters, parcels, books, and speed post dispatches.
trivia: The essential lifeline for dispatching research fellowship forms and receiving holiday care packages from home.

name: Gate 3, Interdisciplinary Research Center
description: Key northern entrance gate leading directly to the Interdisciplinary Research Center and workshop area.
trivia: A landmark entrance for academic researchers visiting high-technology campus institutes.

name: IDC Building
description: Interdisciplinary Centre for Research and Innovation fostering collaborative cross-domain research programs.
trivia: Brings together computer scientists, physicists, and material engineers for multidisciplinary breakthroughs.

name: UoH Campus School Revolver / Security
description: Campus primary and high school providing quality education for the children of university staff and faculty.
trivia: Features lively green playgrounds where annual campus sports days and children's fairs are held.

name: Sajon Ray Kirana
description: Traditional convenience grocery store stocking fresh fruit, dairy, snacks, and daily household essentials.
trivia: A beloved friendly campus store known for fresh bananas, biscuits, and chilled juice packs.

name: Ladies Hostel 9
description: Spacious residential dormitory for women scholars on the eastern South Campus hostels avenue.
trivia: Known for serene garden lawns and active student committee meetings in the recreation lounge.

name: Ladies Hostel 7
description: Postgraduate women's residential hostel with quiet study spaces and internal courtyards.
trivia: Features shaded outdoor study benches surrounded by flowering frangipani trees.

name: Men's Hostel L
description: Residential dormitory complex housing research scholars and master's students on South Campus.
trivia: Famous for high-energy common room table tennis rallies and group study sessions.

name: Faculty A Quarters
description: Peaceful residential quarters for university professors, teaching faculty, and their families.
trivia: Flanked by broad tree-canopied avenues and quiet green gardens.

name: South Gate, University of Hyderabad
description: Grand southern entrance gate of the University of Hyderabad connecting to regional campus highways.
trivia: Marked by historic stone gate pillars and a round-the-clock campus security station.

name: Study India Program (SIP) Building
description: Academic center hosting international exchange students studying Indian history, heritage, and languages.
trivia: Hosts dynamic cultural exchange forums, language workshops, and immersion tours.

name: Central Convocation & Floral Pavilion
description: Grand open-air ceremonial rotunda dome pavilion presiding over the ceremonial gardens.
trivia: Historic site for university honors convocations and commemorative photos.

name: University of Hyderabad Entrance Monument
description: Grand circular stone monolith memorial with concentric ring pillars commemorating the university founding.
trivia: Pinnacle landmark symbol of excellence in higher learning.

name: SATG Shooting Ranges & Athletic Grounds
description: Premier sports marksmanship and athletic training facility with dirt running track and target range.
trivia: Site of university precision shooting championships and sports conditioning.

name: RV Panchajanya Kondapur
description: Vibrant modern high-rise residential complex bordering the north-eastern university enclave.
trivia: Home to many faculty members and scholars enjoying views of the tranquil campus ridge.

name: Sai Baba Temple
description: Beautiful sacred temple with golden gopuram, peaceful stone courtyard, and sacred sanctum.
trivia: Serene spiritual sanctuary nestled beside northern rocky woodlands.

name: Indian Immunologicals Limited
description: Major biopharmaceutical enterprise and biotechnology manufacturing plant advancing global immunology research.
trivia: Collaborates with UoH scholars on pioneering vaccine development and animal health immunology.

name: Overhead Water Tank
description: Iconic elevated sky-blue cylindrical water tower on 4 criss-crossed steel support legs supplying the eastern grid.
trivia: A striking navigation beacon visible from miles around along the Gachibowli highway.

name: GMC Balayogi Athletics Stadium
description: Monumental stadium colosseum arena with professional red synthetic running track hosting university athletics meets.
trivia: Built to Olympic standards with massive spectator tiers and central green arena.

name: Gachibowli Aquatics & Indoor Arena
description: Premier Olympic-size indoor swimming stadium, diving pools, and indoor multi-sport arena.
trivia: Premier aquatic sports complex in Southern India.

name: Sports Turf & Football Field
description: All-weather green turf practice field with goal posts and floodlighting.
trivia: Packed with spirited student football matches every evening.

name: Gachibowli Sports Complex Parking
description: Spacious asphalt visitor parking ground marked by blue P signage.
trivia: Convenient transit hub for sports fans and campus shuttles.
